quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #6
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: What do double solid yellow lines in the middle of the road mean?

options.text: No passing allowed from either direction.
Passing is allowed from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: No passing allowed from either direction.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean you cannot pass from either direction. You may only cross these lines to turn left or pass pedestrians, bicyclists, or scooter riders when it is safe.

questions.question: Why should you use extra caution when driving near a pedestrian with a white cane?
questions.explanation: A white cane means the person is blind. Slow down, give them the right of way, and be ready to stop to keep them safe.

questions.question: At night, when another vehicle is coming toward you, your headlights should be:

options.text: On either high or low beam.

questions.explanation: Switch to low beam headlights when another vehicle is coming toward you at night. High beams can blind other drivers and cause accidents.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks have the right of way.

questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you a steep hill is coming. Slow down and get ready for the steep grade.

questions.question: Traffic moving in opposite directions is divided by ____ lines.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions.

questions.question: Drivers cannot pass from either side of a ____ centerline.
questions.explanation: A double solid yellow line means no passing from either direction is allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a divided highway is coming. Stay in the right lane of the road ahead.

questions.question: Keeping space between your vehicle and others is important because it:

options.text: Gives you time to react to surprises.
Keeps traffic moving at a safe speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Gives you time to react to surprises.
questions.explanation: Space between you and other vehicles gives you time to react if something unexpected happens.

questions.question: What is the best way to stay safe when backing your vehicle?

options.text: Honk your horn before shifting into reverse.
Check behind the vehicle before getting in the driver's seat.
Turn up the radio to get people's attention.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check behind the vehicle before getting in the driver's seat.
questions.explanation: Before backing up, walk around the back of your car to check for children and small objects you might not see from the driver's seat.

questions.question: What do downward-facing triangular signs mean?
questions.explanation: Downward-facing triangular signs tell you to yield. Wait until the road is clear, then proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: Can you cross a double solid yellow centerline to pass another car?

options.text: Yes, if there is no oncoming traffic.
Yes, if the car ahead is driving under the speed limit.

questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean no driver can cross them. The only exception is turning into a driveway or business entrance. Passing over a solid yellow line is never allowed.

questions.question: How can you stay out of a truck or bus driver's blind spot?

options.text: Do not drive next to them and do not follow too closely behind them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not drive next to them and do not follow too closely behind them.
questions.explanation: Trucks and buses have large blind spots on their sides and rear. Stay away from these areas by not driving alongside them and not tailgating.

questions.question: What is defensive driving?

options.text: Spotting dangerous situations and acting to prevent accidents.
Getting ahead of bad drivers by moving through traffic faster.
Following the car ahead of you very closely.
Quickly changing lanes and weaving through traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Spotting dangerous situations and acting to prevent accidents.
questions.explanation: Defensive driving means you identify hazards and take action before an accident happens. It helps you avoid crashes caused by reckless, careless, or impaired drivers.

questions.question: When a bus signals to return to the road after a stop, what must you do?

options.text: Honk to let them know you are there.

questions.explanation: You must yield to any bus that signals to return to the road after stopping. Slow down, change lanes, or stop to let the bus merge safely into traffic.

questions.question: What should you do if another driver is tailgating you?

options.text: Move to the right lane if one is available.
If no right lane is available, wait until the road ahead is clear and slowly reduce your speed to let them pass.

questions.explanation: If being tailgated, move right if possible. If not, slow down gradually when the road ahead is clear to let them pass. Never brake suddenly, as this increases the risk of being hit.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a steady red traffic light?

options.text: Drive through if no other cars are crossing.
Continue driving because you have the right-of-way.
Stop only if a police officer is nearby.

questions.explanation: A red light means you must stop completely. Driving through a red light is illegal and dangerous. You may turn right on a red light only if no sign prohibits it.

questions.question: Your power steering stops working while you are driving. What should you do?

options.text: Honk your horn and turn off the ignition.
Turn on your hazard lights and brace yourself.
Steer firmly, slow down, move to a safe area, and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steer firmly, slow down, move to a safe area, and stop.
questions.explanation: Without power steering, you need extra strength to steer. Reduce your speed and carefully drive to a safe place to stop.

questions.question: How much lane space are motorcycles entitled to?

options.text: The same full lane width as other vehicles.
Half the width of a lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same full lane width as other vehicles.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles have the right to use the full width of a lane, just like cars and trucks.

questions.question: You approach a railroad crossing with flashing warning signals. What should you do?

options.text: Stop and look for a train.
Slow down and look for a train.
Look for a train, then speed up.
Do what the car ahead of you does.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and look for a train.
questions.explanation: When a railroad crossing signal is flashing, you must stop at least 15 feet away from the track. Watch for lowered gates or listen for a train before proceeding.

questions.question: When can you carefully continue through an intersection with a yellow light?

options.text: When an emergency vehicle is crossing your lane.
When you are already in the intersection as the light turns yellow.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you are already in the intersection as the light turns yellow.
questions.explanation: If you are already inside the intersection when the light turns yellow, you may continue through carefully.

questions.question: If you stop at a railroad crossing with more than one track, what should you do?

options.text: Wait until you can see clearly down all tracks before you drive across.
Stop on the first track and watch for another train.
Go through as soon as the train passes.
Go through when one track is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until you can see clearly down all tracks before you drive across.
questions.explanation: Do not move as soon as a train passes. Wait until you can see clearly down all tracks before crossing. Always check again for another train, even if there is only one track.

questions.question: When is it illegal to drive below the speed limit?

options.text: When driving slowly blocks the normal flow of traffic
When in heavy traffic in a construction zone
Only when driving in rural areas

questions.correctAnswerText: When driving slowly blocks the normal flow of traffic
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drive so slowly that you block normal traffic flow. You can receive a ticket for driving too slowly.

questions.question: What can you do to prevent hydroplaning?

options.text: Make sure your tires have good tread.
Slow down when driving in rain.

questions.explanation: To prevent hydroplaning, keep your tires in good condition with proper tread depth and correct air pressure. Slow down when driving in rain. Hydroplaning happens more often at higher speeds.

questions.question: What must a driver do when dealing with pedestrians?

options.text: Make sure the pedestrian sees your vehicle.
Always give pedestrians the right-of-way, even if they are wrong.
Give the right-of-way only when the pedestrian has the legal right.
Slow down and honk your horn near a crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always give pedestrians the right-of-way, even if they are wrong.
questions.explanation: You must do everything to avoid hitting a pedestrian or another vehicle, no matter what. You must always be alert to pedestrians and give them the right-of-way, even if they are crossing where they should not.

questions.question: What helps a person get over the effects of alcohol?
questions.explanation: Only time will help a person get over the effects of alcohol.
